object.attr: stakeholder: these characters reorder how text is displayed, so a requirement can read differently from what is stored; MELLON-VER-SRS-82 marks them in Compare. Ordinary right-to-left text needs none of them, and U+200E and U+200F stay allowed. Decided on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If stored text holds a character from U+202A to U+202E or from U+2066 to U+2069, Mellon should refuse the operation with an error naming the character.
